name: Bhargavastra Counter-Drone System

atlas_legacy_record.note: Values below come from the live legacy atlas page captured on 2026-09-02 and were NOT independently verified in this upgrade pass. They are carried forward for continuity only and must not be cited as evidence.

what_it_is: Bhargavastra is an indigenous Indian counter-swarm drone defence system combining detect-and-destroy layers - hard-kill micro-missiles and gun/soft-kill options - publicly demonstrated to the Indian Army in 2024-2025 trials, with a Wikipedia record of its development.
india_angle: Bhargavastra's public Army demonstrations and Drone Federation of India coverage make it one of the best-evidenced indigenous Indian C-UAS programmes of 2024-25, aimed directly at the swarm-drone threat.
intelligence_assessment: Trial demonstrations are verifiable through multiple outlets; production orders and unit deployments are not yet public. Watch Army procurement notices for the first operational order.

faq.a: An indigenous Indian counter-swarm drone system (missile + gun layers) demonstrated to the Indian Army in 2024-25.
